paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of examples and a metric labeled “minADE20”. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Examples" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, and tick labels are placed at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “minADE20” with a linear scale ranging from 0.60 to 0.66, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01.  A blue line, labeled “ST-ES”, is plotted with circular markers connected by solid line segments; this line begins at approximately (0, 0.648) and generally declines to a minimum value of approximately (2, 0.596) before increasing to approximately (8, 0.604). An orange line, labeled “Random”, is plotted with circular markers connected by solid line segments; this line begins at approximately (0, 0.643) and initially declines to approximately (2, 0.632), then rises to approximately (8, 0.641).
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of examples and minADE20, a metric representing performance. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “minADE20” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.60 to 0.66, with tick marks at 0.60, 0.61, 0.62, 0.63, 0.64, 0.65, and 0.66.  A blue line, labeled “ST-ES”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (0, 0.66) and declines to a value of approximately (1, 0.61), then increases to approximately (2, 0.615), decreases to approximately (3, 0.605), increases to approximately (4, 0.61), and finally decreases to approximately (8, 0.60). An orange line, labeled “Random”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it starts at approximately (0, 0.645) and generally increases, reaching approximately (5, 0.648) before declining to approximately (8, 0.633).
